name: shrooms
description: Watch and run a Shrooms mesh: which peers are reachable, direct or relayed, their traffic, what every device offers and listens on, when each credential expires and the command that renews it, and the daemon's own log. Changes what the daemon can change by itself — name, node mode, services per mesh, blind relays, the domain names answer under, meshes on and off, joining and leaving one — admits a device with a Keycard through the Keycard module, and restarts it to apply them. Opens Shrooms Agents.
